name: inegypt-pages
description: InEgypt website (Plan 47). Eleventy source in src/, output in _site/.

scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run fonts && eleventy
scripts.serve: npm run icons && npm run fonts && eleventy --serve
scripts.check: node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-claims.mjs && node scripts/check-legal.mjs && node scripts/check-css-logical.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs
scripts.all: npm run sync && npm run build && npm run check
